entities.summary: Howard Alvin Stone ForMemRS is the Neil A. Omenn '68 University Professor in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at Princeton University. His field of research is in fluid mechanics, chemical engineering and complex fluids. He became an Editor of the Annual Review of Fluid Mechanics in 2021.
